research.subject: test(ai): record Gemini panel technical no-go

immutableVerdicts.reason: Historically safe but too variable and too severe; not promoted.
Two false negative decisions out of twelve were converted to UNCERTAIN; repeated double-penalty and concise-response underassessment.
Panel stopped after nine usable workflows because an unresolved cost had neither actualCostUsd nor providerRequestId; injection cases were not reached. This is not a pedagogical verdict on Gemini.

requirements: Persist CALL_INTENT and a local idempotency key before network dispatch.
Treat every SENT, CONFIRMED or ORPHANED attempt without cost as RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, with or without a provider request identifier.
Forbid final settlement, release and result publication until reconciliation completes.
Cover null/null, timeout after dispatch, retry and recovery without a second provider call.
Compile one atomic WRITING rubric with no unreachable level, non-monotonic rule, illegal owner or double penalty.
Validate exact response spans and produce a reconstructible evidence certificate.
Keep models unable to return levels, scores, PASS/FAIL, progression effects or freeform feedback.
Keep authentic free-text submission, formative feedback and mastery as three distinct states.
Validate stage mastery only through an independent cumulative deterministic server-side gate.

Build separate mechanical-oracle and semantic-synthetic corpora.
